Training Overview

Depot-based permanent growth

Training lets players gradually gain Attack Power and Resistance over time through trainers at depots. The Character Panel includes a Training section showing current AP and Resistance values, progress bars, and estimated time to the next milestone.

Training Boost Tokens

Boost token behavior
ItemEffect
Training Boost TokenAvailable for 250 Archlight Tokens. Doubles training effectiveness for 1 hour. Duration is stackable.
03

Training Restrictions

While training

Some actions are restricted while training, including spell casting and certain combat interactions. These restrictions keep training as a deliberate activity rather than a passive combat bonus.
